Metadata.title: Variable stream and recording delay for OBS
Metadata.description: Add, cancel, change or remove delay while OBS keeps streaming or recording. Native, efficient and open source.
Metadata.ogAlt: OBS Dynamic Delay — variable delay without stopping your output

Landing.intro: Add up to 300 seconds of delay—or return to live—without restarting your stream or recording.
Landing.featuresIntro: A native dock that works across scenes while the compressed output keeps flowing.

features.title: Change delay live
features.description: Add, cancel, re-arm or remove 1–300 seconds without stopping streaming or recording.

features.title: Audio during the hold scene
features.description: A private audio mix keeps the selected hold scene audible without rewriting global buses.

features.title: Audience preview
features.description: A GPU-downscaled 320×180 preview follows emitted frames without locking OBS video settings.

features.title: Honest memory estimate
features.description: The dock estimates RAM from measured bitrate and shows real usage as the buffer grows.

features.title: Normal OBS workflow
features.description: Switch scenes, use Studio Mode and keep operating OBS normally while delay is active.

features.title: Safe output switching
features.description: Transitions happen on codec-safe keyframes to preserve a decodable A/V bitstream.

Landing.workflowIntro: The plugin changes what the output receives—not how you operate your production.

workflow.title: Prepare
workflow.description: Choose the delay and hold scene. The live program continues while compatible auxiliary encoders get ready.

workflow.title: Fill
workflow.description: At a safe keyframe, viewers see the hold scene while compressed program packets fill the buffer.

workflow.title: Delay—or return live
workflow.description: The buffered program takes over at the target depth. Remove delay whenever you want; no output restart.

Landing.performanceTitle: Spend RAM, not permanent GPU time.
Landing.performanceBody: Video stays compressed in RAM. Matching stream and recording encoders share the same temporary hold pipeline. Preview frames are reduced on the GPU before readback; collapse the preview to release its capture and history.
performancePoints: No permanent decode / composite / re-encode loop
Bounded lock-free PCM bridge; no PCM allocation in Silence mode
Keyframe-safe cuts instead of expensive crossfades
Landing.downloadIntro: Version {version} includes stability fixes, recording-pause handling and a more efficient preview. For OBS Studio 32.2.x; choose your platform and follow the included installation guide.
Landing.allAssets: All files, checksums and release notes
requirements: Encoded audio + video output with exactly one active video track
Hybrid MP4/MOV, standard RTMP and FLV are supported
Disable OBS native Stream Delay before using the plugin
Enhanced Broadcasting / real multi-video output is intentionally unsupported
Landing.transparencyBody: Production mode uses a cut on the next safe keyframe. A real fade between delayed and live video would require permanent decoding, compositing and re-encoding—the exact cost this plugin avoids.
Landing.ctaTitle: Put the delay under your control.
Landing.ctaBody: Download the stable build or inspect every line of the GPL-2.0 source on GitHub.
Landing.footerDescription: Variable delay for OBS streams and recordings, without restarting the output.
Landing.footerBuilt: Built for creators who cannot pause the action.
